verdicts.reason: A shrinks the SOLSTICE logo and wordmark until they can't be read, which breaks the brand. Its CTA is also so big that it competes with the headline, and it wraps into three lines that leave 'Line' on its own. B keeps the sun logo and wordmark readable and sets the CTA as a cleaner, smaller two-line block. B still has flaws: the headline is stacked as one word per line ('Chase / the / Light'), there is a large empty gap above the CTA, and the CTA sits low near the bottom edge.
